purpose: Clean protocol successor after V156 ended in a pre-candidate environment-receipt bookkeeping failure. V157 preserves the V156/V155 reference-blind musical architecture and quality parameters exactly; it changes only model-cache/environment receipt mechanics before candidate creation.

provenance.setupRepairEvidence: V156 run 33142942558 failed before candidate because the receipt assumed ~/.cache/torch/hub/checkpoints while Demucs 4.1 used another cache path; the same block also omitted import os.

song.title: Are You Gonna Go My Way

executionDeterminism.demucsInvocation: in-process demucs.separate.main after all RNG/thread settings are established

triggerSafety.ifDuplicateRunDetected: abort V157 without scoring and move to a fresh version

modelIdentityReceiptRepair.reason: V156 setup failure only; no candidate existed.

timebase.principle: Musical time is derived from audio; audio timestamp 0 is never assumed to be musical grid step 0.
timebase.beatTracker: librosa.beat.beat_track on deterministic onset envelope derived from normalized mix plus separated drums
timebase.tempoMode: dynamic beat times; do not force one constant BPM for event mapping

downbeatPhase.selection: choose deterministic beat-phase index maximizing beat-synchronous accent evidence from normalized mix, drums, and low-frequency/bass evidence; tie break earliest phase index

timebase.leadingGrid: after phase selection, extrapolate whole 4-beat bars backward using robust early local beat period only as needed so earliest detected activity is nonnegative on the musical grid
timebase.eventMapping: piecewise-linear interpolation between detected beat times; each beat spans 4 sixteenth-grid steps; outside tracked range use nearest robust local beat period
timebase.quantization: map raw onset to fractional sixteenth position then deterministically snap to nearest integer sixteenth; preserve startSeconds and rawGridStep

bassRecognition.segmentation: split on detected onset, voiced/unvoiced transition, or stable pitch change >=0.70 semitone sustained >=3 frames
bassRecognition.pitchAssignment: median voiced MIDI per segment rounded to nearest MIDI semitone
bassRecognition.repeatedSamePitch: retain distinct same-pitch notes when a new detected onset occurs

guitarRecognition.architecture: polyphonic Basic Pitch fixed pass plus independent harmonic-CQT evidence

cqt.signal: HPSS harmonic component of guitar stem
cqt.onsetEvidence: positive pitch-salience flux at an independently detected guitar onset

fusion.basicPitchRetention: retain when MIDI has CQT onset support or >=35% CQT support in first 120ms; amplitude >=0.80 may bypass CQT veto
fusion.cqtOnlyCompletion: at detected guitar onsets, add only high-confidence local pitch peaks with positive salience flux, after generic harmonic-duplicate suppression, not within 60ms of an already kept same-MIDI event

postProcessing.deduplicateSameStream: same MIDI and same snapped absolute grid step collapse to one event with deterministic evidence precedence

mustPassBeforeFreeze: Demucs model identity/model blob receipt recorded
all events finite and inside frozen MIDI ranges
all snapped steps integers 0..15 and consistent with absoluteGridStep
beat times strictly increasing and beat-grid arrays aligned
no professional-reference path imported or opened

failurePolicy: Any protocol violation, structural-QC failure after candidate creation, or missed score gate freezes the failure and ends V157. Never repair/retune/select a replacement V157 candidate against professional reference. Pure implementation/setup failures before candidate creation may be repaired only if architecture and preregistration semantics remain unchanged.
